Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
PlantNET Flora of New South Wales

records.source: PlantNET Flora of New South Wales, Hygrophila costata treatment; Kew POWO
records.stems: Bluntly 4-angled, often reddish, glabrous; lower nodes swollen and rooting on ground contact
records.flowers: Axillary clusters of 3–4 sessile flowers; bracts 6–9 × 1.5–3 mm, sparsely hairy; calyx five equal linear lobes 5–9 mm in flower, to 12 mm in fruit; white corolla 5.5–10 mm
records.fruit: Sessile glabrous narrowly oblong capsule 8–13 mm
records.habitat: Wetland/riparian habitat reported by other authorities; not established from 1999 flora
uncertainties: No entry located in the supplied 1999 north-central Texas Acanthaceae treatment; Australian descriptive flora is not direct proof of Central Texas phenology or occurrence

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.leaves: Subsessile, ovate to oval blades to 4 cm long
records.flowers: Solitary axillary or short-peduncled, peduncle <=4 mm, no floral bracts; calyx bractlets to 2.5 mm; lavender, rose or white corolla to 28 mm, slender cylindrical elongated tube, upper lip entire or 2-lobed, much larger 3-lobed lower lip with white patch and purple basal spots; stamens inserted near corolla mouth
records.taxonomic_note: 1999 source uses Siphonoglossa; Kew POWO and ITIS accept Justicia pilosella.

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.leaves: Basal leaves often purplish; petioles 1–4 mm; flora key gives ovate to elliptic 3.5–8 mm wide
records.flowers: Calyx 5–6 mm, lower third of tube saccate; pink corolla 9–13 mm, not inflated; flora key notes corolla upper lip bent at right angle

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.flowers: Finely hirsute calyx 5–6 mm, tube saccate ca. 2/3; blue corolla 7–11 mm; key: peppermint aroma, strongly convergent upper/lower calyx teeth
records.taxonomic_note: Flora reports possible hybridization with H. reverchonii per Irving (1980)

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.habit: Woody-based robust perennial 15–60 cm; prior-season shoots persist
records.leaves: Elliptic-oblong, 6–14 × 2.2–5 mm; gray-green in var. reverchonii
records.flowers: Lemon-scented; calyx 6–7 mm; white or lavender corolla 10–15 mm with upward-expanded tube
records.taxonomic_note: Do not automatically import characters of var. serpyllifolium into modern narrower H. reverchonii.

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.leaves: Elliptic-oblong 6–14 × 2.2–5 mm in species treatment; dark green for var. serpyllifolium
records.flowers: Camphor-scented; calyx 5–6 mm; mainly white, occasionally lavender corolla 8–10 mm, tube only slightly dilated
records.taxonomic_note: POWO accepts Hedeoma serpyllifolia at species rank; ITIS accepts H. reverchonii var. serpyllifolia; retained source's narrower variety characters.

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.habit: Low pubescent annual; stems decumbent basally, often rooting at lower nodes; flowering portion erect/flexuous, 10–45 cm (genus treatment)
records.leaves: Triangular-ovate, blunt coarsely crenate/lobed; upper floral leaf-like bracts sessile and clasping, often wider than long
records.flowers: Dense whorls; densely villous calyces; 2-lipped hooded reddish-pubescent pinkish-purple corolla 10–20 mm (genus treatment), 4 stamens; closed cleistogamous flowers Nov–Feb
records.fruit: Mericarps yellowish to olive-brown with white scaly mottling (genus treatment)
records.nativity_in_1999_flora: Introduced from Europe/Mediterranean to Iran; not BONAP county finding

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.habit: Low pubescent annual; stems basal decumbent and ascending above, 10–45 cm (genus treatment)
records.leaves: Petioled floral leaf-like bracts longer than wide, often reflexed; blades and bracts green often tinged purple; crenate rather than lobed
records.flowers: Dense whorls; calyces glabrous or sparsely hairy; 2-lipped hooded purple corolla 10–20 mm (genus treatment), 4 stamens
records.fruit: Mericarps yellowish to olive-brown with white scaly mottling (genus treatment)
records.taxonomic_note: Var. purpureum vs var. incisum distinguished by shallow regular crenation vs deep irregular incisions in flora
records.nativity_in_1999_flora: Introduced from Europe/Mediterranean; not BONAP county finding

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.habit: Aromatic perennial 0.3–0.7(–1) m, conspicuous white tomentum often with stellate hairs; old plants woody-rooted
records.leaves: Broadly ovate to suborbicular 1.5–5 cm long, petiolate, toothed, wrinkled venation
records.flowers: Spaced dense axillary clusters; calyx 4–5 mm usually with 10 teeth, some hooked; bilabiate white corolla 5–6 mm, often rose-purple spotted, 4 stamens
records.habitat: Eroding or disturbed limestone soils, waste land, high-nitrogen livestock spots
records.nativity_in_1999_flora: Introduced from Eurasia, Mediterranean and Macaronesia; not BONAP county finding

records.source: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon 1999, Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
records.flowers: Interrupted spikes of 2–7 floral heads (key); hispid-margined bracts and calyces; often-purple bract inner surfaces and 2–5 mm spinose bristle; calyx teeth bristle-tipped 2–7 mm; white/pink/lavender corolla with purple dots, tube 7–19 mm; genus: 2 stamens and bilabiate corolla

holds.reason: Accepted by POWO; no matching treatment found in supplied 1999 north-central Texas flora; requires regionally appropriate source before morphology extraction

nativity: BONAP county-level evaluation separately pending for every record. No family-wide or Texas-wide assumption.
data_handling: Standalone researched source facts only; no alteration to original species, images, credits or public site.
